pull.title: depends: Update Qt to 6.8.4
pull.body:
Release notes: https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/qtreleasenotes.git/about/qt/6.8.4/release-note.md

`depends/patches/qt/qtbase_platformsupport.patch` has been dropped as the fix was backported upstream in https://github.com/qt/qtbase/commit/5afcc64fd774ba7337b688841a852d1a1a242554.
